stem: Which sentence from the article helps explain why staring at a computer screen affects blink rates?

options.label: A
options.text: Then blink rates decrease as people move into older adulthood.

options.label: B
options.text: After 30 seconds you probably struggle to resist closing and then reopening your eyes.

options.label: C
options.text: You’ll blink less when you’re concentrating on something.

options.label: D
options.text: When you’re thinking but not actually looking at something, your blink rate will also decrease.
